caption: The drawing features a rectangular wooden chest with a flat brown top and blue sides. The front of the chest is divided into three panels, each with an arched top. The two side panels each display a symmetrical floral motif with two birds facing a central flower, all in muted tones of red, orange, green, and blue against a light beige background. The middle panel features a stylized floral design with a central flower and two sets of smaller botanicals on either side, also in muted colors. Vertical stripes of green, blue, and yellow separate the panels. Metal handles are attached to each side of the chest, and it has small feet at each corner. The chest casts a faint shadow on a plain, light background. The signature "Bernard Krieger" appears in the lower left corner of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
